description.narrative: Following the recent assessment of the state of art of TVET in the country, UNESCO is now leading the process of developing the TVET Strategy for the next 10 years. On the other hand, UNESCO has been supporting the higher Education sub-sector, particularly the new universities established in the central and northern Mozambique. Considering these two commitments in a more holistic vision, UNESCO will continue to boost the development of STEM education, mainstreaming women and girls, in alignment with the new GoM strategies that promote the reduction of inequalities (in terms of gender, northern-central-southern regions of the country, urban vs. rural communities, etc.).
